summary: APPROVE. The round-2 v4 contract covers all fourteen acceptance criteria with required test cases and observable evidence. The expiry/key-revocation terminal path now explicitly permits authorized observation/finalization while requiring zero provider write/retry; the stale-terminal path now requires provider-first observation, no persistence under the expired lease, exactly one expected-generation PostgreSQL takeover winner, exact immutable-result finalization under the new lease, and fenced losers; and TC-10/CMD-04/EV-07 now bind the static typed CapabilityRegistry/no-plugin/no-vendor claim to exact-candidate changed-path, dependency, architecture, and focused-test evidence. The remaining recovery, authorization, retry, idempotency, crash-window, audit, HTTP-mapping, migration and concurrency requirements are represented by required cases/evidence, and Issue #79 release-harness/final-gate work remains explicitly out of scope.
